```{r Cleaning Data}
df_labeled <- cfbd_betting_lines(year = 2024, season_type = "regular") %>%
  mutate(
    actual_total = as.numeric(home_score) + as.numeric(away_score),
    ou_result = case_when(
      !is.na(actual_total) & !is.na(over_under) & actual_total >  over_under ~ "Over",
      !is.na(actual_total) & !is.na(over_under) & actual_total <  over_under ~ "Under",
      !is.na(actual_total) & !is.na(over_under) & actual_total == over_under ~ "Push",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    ou_binary = case_when(
      ou_result == "Over"  ~ 1L,
      ou_result == "Under" ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    )
  )

```

```{r Random Forest} 
# Splitting Data
set.seed(42)
spl <- initial_split(full_data, prop = 0.7)
train_df <- training(spl)
test_df  <- testing(spl)

rec <- recipe(actual_total ~ ., data = train_df) %>%
  step_rm(game_id, home_team, away_team, ou_binary, ou_result,
          notes, season_type, seasonType, formatted_spread, provider,
          start_time_tbd, start_date, completed, home_division, away_division,
          highlights, home_score, away_score, home_points, away_points) %>%
  step_string2factor(all_nominal_predictors()) %>%
  step_zv(all_predictors()) %>%
  step_impute_knn(all_predictors(), neighbors = 5)

prep_rec <- prep(rec, training = train_df)
train_proc <- bake(prep_rec, new_data = train_df)
test_proc  <- bake(prep_rec, new_data = test_df)

# Training Model
set.seed(123)
rf_reg <- ranger(
  actual_total ~ .,
  data = train_proc,
  num.trees = 500,
  importance = "permutation",
)

# Testing Model
pred_total <- predict(rf_reg, data = test_proc)$predictions

pred_class <- ifelse(pred_total > test_proc$over_under, "Over", "Under")

cm <- confusionMatrix(
  factor(pred_class, levels = c("Under","Over")),
  factor(test_df$ou_result, levels = c("Under","Over")),
  positive = "Over"
)
cm


pred_total <- predict(rf_reg, data = test_proc)$predictions  
margin <- pred_total - test_proc$over_under 

library(pROC)
truth <- factor(test_df$ou_result, levels = c("Under","Over"))
roc_obj <- roc(response = truth, predictor = margin, levels = c("Under","Over"), direction = "<")
print(auc(roc_obj))

roc_df <- tibble(
  FPR = 1 - roc_obj$specificities,
  TPR = roc_obj$sensitivities
)

ggplot(roc_df, aes(FPR, TPR)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = paste0("ROC Curve (AUC = ", round(auc(roc_obj), 3), ")"),
       x = "False Positive Rate", y = "True Positive Rate") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

```

```{r}
temp2 <- load_cfb_pbp(2024)
```



```{r Creating Window} 
home_pass_epa <- away_pass_epa <- home_rush_epa <- away_rush_epa<- rep(NA, nrow(full_data))
window = 5

for (i in seq_len(nrow(full_data))) {
  t1 <- temp2[
    temp2$pos_team == full_data$home_team[i] &
    temp2$week <  full_data$week[i] &
    temp2$week >= full_data$week[i] - window, ]

  if (nrow(t1) > 0) {
    home_pass_epa[i] <- mean(t1$EPA[t1$pass == 1 | t1$pass == TRUE], na.rm = TRUE)
    home_rush_epa[i] <- mean(t1$EPA[t1$rush == 1 | t1$rush == TRUE], na.rm = TRUE)
  }

  t2 <- temp2[
    temp2$pos_team == full_data$away_team[i] &
    temp2$week <  full_data$week[i] &
    temp2$week >= full_data$week[i] - window, ]

  if (nrow(t2) > 0) {
    away_pass_epa[i] <- mean(t2$EPA[t2$pass == 1 | t2$pass == TRUE], na.rm = TRUE)
    away_rush_epa[i] <- mean(t2$EPA[t2$rush == 1 | t2$rush == TRUE], na.rm = TRUE)
  }
}
```



```{r}
full_data$home_pass_epa <- home_pass_epa
full_data$home_rush_epa <- home_rush_epa
full_data$away_pass_epa <- away_pass_epa
full_data$away_rush_epa <- away_rush_epa
```






```{r Derived Variables}

n <- nrow(full_data)
home_rz_epa        <- away_rz_epa        <- rep(NA_real_, n)
home_q4_epa        <- away_q4_epa        <- rep(NA_real_, n)
home_pen_yds_pg    <- away_pen_yds_pg    <- rep(NA_real_, n)
home_min_per_point <- away_min_per_point <- rep(NA_real_, n)

for (i in seq_len(n)) {
  wk_i <- full_data$week[i]
  home <- full_data$home_team[i]
  away <- full_data$away_team[i]

  t1 <- temp2[
    temp2$pos_team == home &
    temp2$week <  wk_i &
    temp2$week >= wk_i - window,
  , drop = FALSE]

  t2 <- temp2[
    temp2$pos_team == away &
    temp2$week <  wk_i &
    temp2$week >= wk_i - window,
  , drop = FALSE]

  # Red Zone EPA
  if (nrow(t1) > 0 && all(c("yards_to_goal","EPA") %in% names(t1))) {
    home_rz_epa[i] <- mean(t1$EPA[t1$yards_to_goal <= 20], na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  if (nrow(t2) > 0 && all(c("yards_to_goal","EPA") %in% names(t2))) {
    away_rz_epa[i] <- mean(t2$EPA[t2$yards_to_goal <= 20], na.rm = TRUE)
  }

  # 4Q Epa
  if (nrow(t1) > 0 && all(c("period","EPA") %in% names(t1))) {
    home_q4_epa[i] <- mean(t1$EPA[t1$period == 4], na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  if (nrow(t2) > 0 && all(c("period","EPA") %in% names(t2))) {
    away_q4_epa[i] <- mean(t2$EPA[t2$period == 4], na.rm = TRUE)
  }

  if (nrow(t1) > 0 && all(c("yds_penalty","game_id") %in% names(t1))) {
    home_pen_sum <- sum(t1$yds_penalty, na.rm = TRUE)
    home_games_n <- length(unique(t1$game_id))
    home_pen_yds_pg[i] <- if (home_games_n > 0) home_pen_sum / home_games_n else NA_real_
  }
  if (nrow(t2) > 0 && all(c("yds_penalty","game_id") %in% names(t2))) {
    away_pen_sum <- sum(t2$yds_penalty, na.rm = TRUE)
    away_games_n <- length(unique(t2$game_id))
    away_pen_yds_pg[i] <- if (away_games_n > 0) away_pen_sum / away_games_n else NA_real_
  }
}

full_data$home_rz_epa      <- home_rz_epa
full_data$away_rz_epa      <- away_rz_epa
full_data$home_q4_epa      <- home_q4_epa
full_data$away_q4_epa      <- away_q4_epa
full_data$home_pen_yds_pg  <- home_pen_yds_pg
full_data$away_pen_yds_pg  <- away_pen_yds_pg
```


```{r Random Forest w/ Derived Variables abd removed "ppa" stats}

set.seed(42)
spl <- initial_split(full_data, prop = 0.7)
train_df <- training(spl)
test_df  <- testing(spl)


rec <- recipe(actual_total ~ ., data = train_df) %>%
  step_rm(
    game_id, home_team, away_team, ou_binary, ou_result, 
    notes, season_type, seasonType, formatted_spread, provider,
    start_time_tbd, start_date, completed, home_division, away_division,
    highlights, home_score, away_score, home_points, away_points
  ) %>%

  step_rm(contains("ppa", ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
  step_string2factor(all_nominal_predictors()) %>%
  step_zv(all_predictors()) %>%
  step_impute_knn(all_predictors(), neighbors = 5)

prep_rec  <- prep(rec, training = train_df)
train_proc <- bake(prep_rec, new_data = train_df)
test_proc  <- bake(prep_rec, new_data = test_df)

set.seed(123)
rf_reg <- ranger(
  actual_total ~ .,
  data = train_proc,
  num.trees = 500,
  importance = "permutation"
)

pred_total <- predict(rf_reg, data = test_proc)$predictions
pred_class <- ifelse(pred_total > test_proc$over_under, "Over", "Under")

cm <- confusionMatrix(
  factor(pred_class, levels = c("Under","Over")),
  factor(test_df$ou_result, levels = c("Under","Over")),
  positive = "Over"
)
print(cm)

margin <- pred_total - test_proc$over_under
truth  <- factor(test_df$ou_result, levels = c("Under","Over"))

roc_obj <- roc(response = truth, predictor = margin,
               levels = c("Under","Over"), direction = "<")
auc_val <- auc(roc_obj)
print(auc_val)

roc_df <- tibble(FPR = 1 - roc_obj$specificities,
                 TPR = roc_obj$sensitivities)

ggplot(roc_df, aes(FPR, TPR)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = paste0("ROC Curve (AUC = ", round(auc_val, 3), ")"),
       x = "False Positive Rate", y = "True Positive Rate") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

```

```{r Starting 2025 Prediciton}
    actual_total = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(home_score) + as.numeric(away_score)),
    ou_result = case_when(

      ou_result == "Under" ~ 0L,
```

```{r Adv Stats 2025 + Filtering}
full_data_2025 <- full_data_2025 %>%
  mutate(
    season      = dplyr::coalesce(season, season.info),
    season_type = dplyr::coalesce(season_type, seasonType, season_type.info),
    week        = suppressWarnings(as.integer(dplyr::coalesce(week, week.info))),
    start_date  = dplyr::coalesce(start_date, start_date.info),

    home_team   = dplyr::coalesce(home_team, home_team.info),
    away_team   = dplyr::coalesce(away_team, away_team.info),
    spread      = dplyr::coalesce(spread, spread),
    over_under  = dplyr::coalesce(over_under, over_under),
    provider    = dplyr::coalesce(provider, provider)
  ) %>%
  select(
    -any_of(c("season.info","seasonType","season_type.info",
              "week.info","start_date.info",
              "home_team.info","away_team.info",
              "spread.info","over_under.info","provider.info"))
  ) %>%
  distinct(game_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  filter(week > 1)
```

```{r Derived Variables}
if (!exists("pbp_2025")) {
  pbp_2025 <- cfbfastR::load_cfb_pbp(2025)
}
pbp_2025       <- as.data.frame(pbp_2025)
full_data_2025 <- as.data.frame(full_data_2025)
full_data_2025$week <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(full_data_2025$week))

window <- 5
n <- nrow(full_data_2025)

pick_col <- function(df, candidates) {
  nm <- intersect(candidates, names(df))
  if (length(nm) == 0) NA_character_ else nm[1]
}


pos_col    <- pick_col(temp2025, c("pos_team","offense","offense_team"))
week_col   <- pick_col(temp2025, c("week","game_week"))
epa_col    <- pick_col(temp2025, c("EPA","epa"))
pass_col   <- pick_col(temp2025, c("pass","Pass","is_pass"))
rush_col   <- pick_col(temp2025, c("rush","Rush","is_rush"))
period_col <- pick_col(temp2025, c("period","qtr","quarter"))
ytg_col    <- pick_col(temp2025, c("yards_to_goal","yardline_100"))
pen_col    <- pick_col(temp2025, c("yds_penalty","penalty_yards","penalty_yds"))
gid_col    <- pick_col(temp2025, c("game_id","gameId","gameid"))

pbp_2025[[week_col]] <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(pbp_2025[[week_col]]))
if (!is.na(pass_col)) pbp_2025[[pass_col]] <- as.integer(pbp_2025[[pass_col]] %in% c(1, TRUE))
if (!is.na(rush_col)) pbp_2025[[rush_col]] <- as.integer(pbp_2025[[rush_col]] %in% c(1, TRUE))

home_rz_epa        <- away_rz_epa        <- rep(NA_real_, n)
home_q4_epa        <- away_q4_epa        <- rep(NA_real_, n)
home_pen_yds_pg    <- away_pen_yds_pg    <- rep(NA_real_, n)
home_min_per_point <- away_min_per_point <- rep(NA_real_, n)
home_pass_epa      <- away_pass_epa      <- rep(NA_real_, n) 
home_rush_epa      <- away_rush_epa      <- rep(NA_real_, n) 

for (i in seq_len(n)) {
  wk_i <- full_data_2025$week[i]
  hm   <- full_data_2025$home_team[i]
  aw   <- full_data_2025$away_team[i]
  if (is.na(wk_i) || is.na(hm) || is.na(aw)) next

  home_mask <- (pbp_2025[[pos_col]] == hm) &
               (pbp_2025[[week_col]] <  wk_i) &
               (pbp_2025[[week_col]] >= wk_i - window)
  home_mask[is.na(home_mask)] <- FALSE

  away_mask <- (pbp_2025[[pos_col]] == aw) &
               (pbp_2025[[week_col]] <  wk_i) &
               (pbp_2025[[week_col]] >= wk_i - window)
  away_mask[is.na(away_mask)] <- FALSE

  t1 <- pbp_2025[home_mask, , drop = FALSE]
  t2 <- pbp_2025[away_mask, , drop = FALSE]

  if (!is.na(epa_col) && !is.na(pass_col) && nrow(t1) > 0)
    home_pass_epa[i] <- mean(t1[[epa_col]][t1[[pass_col]] == 1], na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.na(epa_col) && !is.na(rush_col) && nrow(t1) > 0)
    home_rush_epa[i] <- mean(t1[[epa_col]][t1[[rush_col]] == 1], na.rm = TRUE)

  if (!is.na(epa_col) && !is.na(pass_col) && nrow(t2) > 0)
    away_pass_epa[i] <- mean(t2[[epa_col]][t2[[pass_col]] == 1], na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.na(epa_col) && !is.na(rush_col) && nrow(t2) > 0)
    away_rush_epa[i] <- mean(t2[[epa_col]][t2[[rush_col]] == 1], na.rm = TRUE)
}


for (i in seq_len(n)) {
  wk_i <- full_data_2025$week[i]
  hm   <- full_data_2025$home_team[i]
  aw   <- full_data_2025$away_team[i]
  if (is.na(wk_i) || is.na(hm) || is.na(aw)) next

  home_mask <- (pbp_2025[[pos_col]] == hm) &
               (pbp_2025[[week_col]] <  wk_i) &
               (pbp_2025[[week_col]] >= wk_i - window)
  home_mask[is.na(home_mask)] <- FALSE

  away_mask <- (pbp_2025[[pos_col]] == aw) &
               (pbp_2025[[week_col]] <  wk_i) &
               (pbp_2025[[week_col]] >= wk_i - window)
  away_mask[is.na(away_mask)] <- FALSE

  t1 <- pbp_2025[home_mask, , drop = FALSE]
  t2 <- pbp_2025[away_mask, , drop = FALSE]

  if (!is.na(epa_col) && !is.na(pass_col) && nrow(t1) > 0)
    home_pass_epa[i] <- mean(t1[[epa_col]][t1[[pass_col]] == 1], na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.na(epa_col) && !is.na(rush_col) && nrow(t1) > 0)
    home_rush_epa[i] <- mean(t1[[epa_col]][t1[[rush_col]] == 1], na.rm = TRUE)

  if (!is.na(epa_col) && !is.na(pass_col) && nrow(t2) > 0)
    away_pass_epa[i] <- mean(t2[[epa_col]][t2[[pass_col]] == 1], na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.na(epa_col) && !is.na(rush_col) && nrow(t2) > 0)
    away_rush_epa[i] <- mean(t2[[epa_col]][t2[[rush_col]] == 1], na.rm = TRUE)
}

  if (!is.na(pen_col) && !is.na(gid_col) && nrow(t1) > 0) {
    pen_sum <- sum(t1[[pen_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
    g_n     <- length(unique(t1[[gid_col]]))
    home_pen_yds_pg[i] <- if (g_n > 0) pen_sum / g_n else NA_real_
  }
  if (!is.na(pen_col) && !is.na(gid_col) && nrow(t2) > 0) {
    pen_sum <- sum(t2[[pen_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
    g_n     <- length(unique(t2[[gid_col]]))
    away_pen_yds_pg[i] <- if (g_n > 0) pen_sum / g_n else NA_real_
  }

full_data_2025$home_pass_epa <- home_pass_epa
full_data_2025$home_rush_epa <- home_rush_epa
full_data_2025$away_pass_epa <- away_pass_epa
full_data_2025$away_rush_epa <- away_rush_epa
full_data_2025$home_rz_epa   <- home_rz_epa
full_data_2025$away_rz_epa   <- away_rz_epa
full_data_2025$home_q4_epa   <- home_q4_epa
full_data_2025$away_q4_epa   <- away_q4_epa
full_data_2025$home_pen_yds_pg  <- home_pen_yds_pg
full_data_2025$away_pen_yds_pg  <- away_pen_yds_pg

```

```{r Train/Test}
current_week <- 13
wk_train_max <- current_week - 1
wk_test <- current_week

train_df <- full_data_2025 %>%
  filter(week <= wk_train_max, !is.na(actual_total))
test_df  <- full_data_2025 %>% filter(week == wk_test)

test_df  <- test_df %>% filter(!is.na(over_under))
```

```{r Removing Certain Columns/Imputing}
rec <- recipe(actual_total ~ ., data = train_df) %>%
  step_rm(
    game_id, home_team, away_team, ou_binary, ou_result,
    start_date, provider, notes, venue,
    home_points, away_points
  ) %>%
  step_mutate(across(where(is.logical), ~ as.integer(.))) %>%
  step_string2factor(all_nominal_predictors()) %>%
  step_zv(all_predictors()) %>%
  step_impute_knn(all_predictors(), neighbors = 5) %>%
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors(), one_hot = TRUE)
```

```{r Prep}
prep_rec <- prep(rec, training = train_df)
train_mat <- bake(prep_rec, new_data = train_df)
test_mat  <- bake(prep_rec, new_data = test_df)
```

```{r}
X_train <- as.matrix(select(train_mat, -actual_total))
y_train <- train_mat$actual_total
dtrain  <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X_train, label = y_train)

X_test <- as.matrix(select(test_mat, -actual_total))
dtest  <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X_test)
```

```{r XGBoost}
max_depth_vals      <- c(3, 5, 7, 10)
min_child_weight_vals <- c(1, 3, 5, 7, 10)

cv_params <- expand.grid(
  max_depth = max_depth_vals,
  min_child_weight = min_child_weight_vals
)

rmse_vec      <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(cv_params))
best_iter_vec <- rep(NA_integer_, nrow(cv_params))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(cv_params))) {
  set.seed(111111)

  bst_tune <- xgb.cv(
    data  = dtrain,
    nfold = 5,              
    eta   = 0.10,          
    max_depth        = cv_params$max_depth[i],
    min_child_weight = cv_params$min_child_weight[i],
    gamma            = 0,
    subsample        = 0.8,
    colsample_bytree = 0.8,

    nrounds = 600,    
    early_stopping_rounds = 30,

    verbose = 1,
    print_every_n = 50,
    nthread = 1,

    objective  = "reg:squarederror",
    eval_metric = "rmse"
  )

  rmse_vec[i]      <- bst_tune$evaluation_log$test_rmse_mean[bst_tune$best_iteration]
  best_iter_vec[i] <- bst_tune$best_iteration
}

rmse_vec[i]      <- bst_tune$evaluation_log$test_rmse_mean[bst_tune$best_iteration]
best_iter_vec[i] <- bst_tune$best_iteration

res_db <- cbind.data.frame(cv_params, rmse = rmse_vec, best_iter = best_iter_vec) %>%
  arrange(rmse)

print(res_db)
```

```{r}
res_db$max_depth        <- as.factor(res_db$max_depth)
res_db$min_child_weight <- as.factor(res_db$min_child_weight)

g_rmse <- ggplot(res_db, aes(x = min_child_weight, y = max_depth, fill = rmse)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "red", mid = "white", high = "blue",
    midpoint = median(res_db$rmse, na.rm = TRUE),
    name = "CV RMSE"
  ) +
  labs(x = "Minimum Child Weight", y = "Max Depth",
       title = "XGBoost CV (eta=0.10): RMSE by Depth × Min Child Weight")
g_rmse
```

```{r}
gamma_vals <- c(0, 0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 1, 2)

auc_vec   <- error_vec <- rep(NA, length(gamma_vals))
best_iter <- rep(NA, length(gamma_vals))

for(i in seq_along(gamma_vals)){
  set.seed(111111)
  bst_tune <- xgb.cv(
    data = dtrain,
    nfold = 5, 
    eta = 0.1,                  
    max.depth = 3,              
    min_child_weight = 5,        
    gamma = gamma_vals[i],     
    nrounds = 600,            
    early_stopping_rounds = 20, 
    verbose = 1,
    nthread = 1,
    print_every_n = 20,
    objective = "reg:squarederror", 
    eval_metric = "rmse"
  )
  
  best_iter[i] <- bst_tune$best_iteration
  auc_vec[i]   <- bst_tune$evaluation_log$test_rmse_mean[bst_tune$best_iteration]
  error_vec[i] <- bst_tune$evaluation_log$test_rmse_std[bst_tune$best_iteration]
}

res_gamma <- data.frame(
  gamma = gamma_vals,
  rmse = auc_vec,
  rmse_sd = error_vec,
  best_iter = best_iter
)

print(res_gamma)
```

```{r}
g_gamma <- ggplot(res_gamma, aes(x = factor(gamma), y = rmse, fill = gamma)) +
  geom_col() +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Gamma", y = "Test RMSE", title = "XGBoost Tuning: Gamma (max_depth=3, min_child_weight=7)") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

print(g_gamma)
```

```{r Tuning subsample and colsample_by_tree_parameters}
subsample_vals       <- c(0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 1.0)
colsample_bytree_vals <- c(0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 1.0)

cv_params <- expand.grid(
  subsample = subsample_vals,
  colsample_bytree = colsample_bytree_vals
)

rmse_vec      <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(cv_params))
rmse_sd_vec   <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(cv_params))
best_iter_vec <- rep(NA_integer_, nrow(cv_params))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(cv_params))) {
  set.seed(111111)
  bst_tune <- xgb.cv(
    data  = dtrain,
    nfold = 5,
    eta              = 0.10,
    max_depth        = 3,
    min_child_weight = 5,
    gamma            = 0,
    subsample        = cv_params$subsample[i],
    colsample_bytree = cv_params$colsample_bytree[i],
    nrounds = 1000,
    early_stopping_rounds = 20,
    verbose = 1,
    nthread = 1,
    print_every_n = 50,
    objective   = "reg:squarederror",
    eval_metric = "rmse"
  )
  best_iter_vec[i] <- bst_tune$best_iteration
  rmse_vec[i]      <- bst_tune$evaluation_log$test_rmse_mean[bst_tune$best_iteration]
  rmse_sd_vec[i]   <- bst_tune$evaluation_log$test_rmse_std[bst_tune$best_iteration]
}

res_subcol <- cv_params %>%
  mutate(rmse = rmse_vec,
         rmse_sd = rmse_sd_vec,
         best_iter = best_iter_vec) %>%
  arrange(rmse)

print(res_subcol)
```

```{r}
res_plot <- res_subcol %>% filter(!is.na(rmse))
res_plot$subsample        <- as.factor(res_plot$subsample)
res_plot$colsample_bytree <- as.factor(res_plot$colsample_bytree)

mid_val <- ifelse(length(unique(res_plot$rmse)) > 1,
                  median(res_plot$rmse, na.rm = TRUE),
                  unique(res_plot$rmse)[1])

g_subcol <- ggplot(res_plot, aes(x = colsample_bytree, y = subsample, fill = rmse)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "red", mid = "white", high = "blue",
    midpoint = mid_val,
    name = "CV RMSE"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "colsample_bytree",
    y = "subsample",
    title = "XGBoost CV Heatmap (eta=0.10, depth=3, min_child=7, gamma=0)"
  )
print(g_subcol)
```

```{r Tuning ETA}

eta_vals <- c(0.3, 0.1, 0.05, 0.01)

results <- data.frame(
  eta = eta_vals,
  best_iter = NA_integer_,
  test_rmse = NA_real_
)

models <- list()

for (i in seq_along(eta_vals)) {
  
  set.seed(111111)
  bst_cv <- xgb.cv(
    data  = dtrain,
    nfold = 5,
    nrounds = 1000,             
    early_stopping_rounds = 20,
    verbose = 1,
    print_every_n = 20,
    objective   = "reg:squarederror",
    eval_metric = "rmse",
    eta              = eta_vals[i],
    max_depth        = 3,
    min_child_weight = 5,
    gamma            = 0,
    subsample        = 1,
    colsample_bytree = 1
  )
  
  results$best_iter[i] <- bst_cv$best_iteration
  results$test_rmse[i] <- bst_cv$evaluation_log$test_rmse_mean[bst_cv$best_iteration]
  
  bst_final <- xgb.train(
    params = list(
      objective        = "reg:squarederror",
      eval_metric      = "rmse",
      eta              = .05,
      max_depth        = 3,
      min_child_weight = 7,
      gamma            = 0,
      subsample        = .7,
      colsample_bytree = 1
    ),
    data    = dtrain,
    nrounds = bst_cv$best_iteration,
    watchlist = list(train = dtrain),
    verbose = 0
  )
  
  models[[paste0("eta_", eta_vals[i])]] <- bst_final
}

print(results)
```

```{r}
ggplot(results, aes(x = factor(eta), y = test_rmse, fill = factor(eta))) +
  geom_col() +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "XGBoost CV RMSE by eta (subsample=0.7, colsample_bytree=1)",
    x = "Learning Rate (eta)", y = "Test RMSE"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
```{r Best Model}
final_params <- list(
  objective        = "reg:squarederror",
  eval_metric      = "rmse",
  eta              = 0.05, 
  max_depth        = 3,
  min_child_weight = 5,
  gamma            = 0,
  subsample        = 1,
  colsample_bytree = 1.0
)

set.seed(111111)
cv_final <- xgb.cv(
  params = final_params,
  data   = dtrain,
  nfold  = 5,
  nrounds = 1500,
  early_stopping_rounds = 20,
  verbose = 1,
  print_every_n = 100
)

best_iter <- cv_final$best_iteration

# Train final model
set.seed(111111)
bst_model <- xgb.train(
  params  = final_params,
  data    = dtrain,
  nrounds = best_iter,
  watchlist = list(train = dtrain),
  verbose = 1,
  print_every_n = 100
)

```


```{r}
pred_total <- predict(bst_model, dtest)
pred_pick  <- ifelse(pred_total > test_mat$over_under, "Over", "Under")
pred_margin <- pred_total - test_mat$over_under

pred_tbl <- test_df %>%
  select(game_id, week, home_team, away_team, over_under, actual_total, ou_result) %>%
  mutate(
    pred_total = pred_total,
    margin = pred_margin,
    pick   = pred_pick
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(margin)))

print(pred_tbl)
```

```{r}
write_xlsx(pred_tbl, "Julian Predictions WK8.xlsx")
```
